headline: Ben Bernanke on modern *bank runs*
quote: investors in this fund and then in other money market funds
title: Bernanke: How money market funds suffered a classic bank run
caption: Ben Bernanke outlines how the collapse of Lehman Brothers caused money market funds to break the buck. Nervous investors panicked and rushed to withdraw cash just like 19th-century bank depositors.
comment: Have you ever used a money market fund assuming it was completely risk-free?
